messages:
Alyssa: heads-up — we need a final call on the staged burst policy scope for Dedicated. Customer asks keep coming; we should decide MVP vs v1+.
Sam: want to avoid overcommitting eng. can we land a narrow MVP that unblocks sales?
Priya: agreed. propose MVP = per-tenant fixed burst bands + simple spillover rule + canary routing. no predictive shaping yet.
Leo: from sales — three pilots (FinSys, Adlytics, MedFlow) require guaranteed burst windows and billing clarity. they want explicit contract terms for burst credits.
Mica: note: solutions will need an ops knob for manual evict/hold in emergencies. add small UI toggle for canary customers?
Jordan: SRE caveats: MVP must include observability (burst utilization, preempt events) and a preemption-metric-based alarm. we can reuse existing metrics but need 1 additional histogram.
Alyssa: product ask: define launch criteria — 1) 5 pilot customers onboarded, 2) no critical regressions in 72h canary, 3) billing mapping doc + API contract.
Sam: engineering estimate: core runtime changes ~3w (batching + per-tenant band tracking), API + quota plumbing ~1w, telemetry + canary infra ~1w. total ~5w with 2 engineers + 1 SRE.
Priya: priority tradeoffs: we can defer dynamic burst smoothing and ML-based prediction to post-launch. shipping quick wins helps renewals.
Leo: commercial requirement: burst must be represented as a separate line item or token bucket on invoices. finance needs schema by T-minus 3w.
Mica: for rollout, recommend staged canary: internal -> 2 friendly pilots -> 3 broader pilots -> GA. each stage min 72h and success signal is <1% latency SLO violations for burst traffic.
Jordan: also require a fallback policy: if headroom < 10% for two consecutive 1m windows, auto-fallback to baseline model variant. that prevents noisy neighbor issues.
Sam: implementation detail: propose config API shape: 
``` 
POST /v1/dedicated/pools/:pool_id/burst-policies
{
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "burst_band": { "size_tokens": 500000, "window_secs": 3600 },
  "spillover": "allow|deny",
  "preempt_policy": "graceful|immediate"
}
```
We'll keep fields minimal for MVP.
Alyssa: good — call out non-goals: no cross-tenant pooled burst, no per-request predictive autothrottling, no billing metering for partial tokens (round to minute).
Emily: CS: onboarding playbook should include sample contract language, how to measure burst usage, and a rollback checklist (feature flag + quick disable).
Leo: we should also surface expected cost delta per pilot — even a rough number helps negotiations.
Priya: dependencies: billing schema (finance), console toggle (devex), telemetry histogram (sre), contract templates (legal). owner list: Sam (eng), Jordan (sre), Mica (solutions), Leo (sales).
Alyssa: decision proposal: ship MVP as defined, aim for pilot kickoff in 6w, GA in 12w contingent on pilots. objections?
Sam: no objections technically; need headcount buffer if blockers appear.
Jordan: +1, but add automated test for preempt fallback to avoid regressions.
Mica: +1 from solutions. request a short demo script for pilots.
Leo: +1 sales. will line up the three pilots and share contract asks by EOD Friday.
Priya: I'll put a phased JIRA board together and tag owners.
DeployBot: scheduled canary window created for pool 'pilot-eu-1' starting 2026-04-05T08:00Z.
Alyssa: thanks. I'll convert this thread into a PRD skeleton and share first draft tomorrow.
